edits.old: - No personal data in events, logs, workflow inputs or payloads: the events name case ids, the item id, the interface id, the business date, the attempt count and the document id only; the file carries personal data only as the receiving interface allows, and the content stays in rwb-document behind a SAS link.
edits.new:
- No personal data in events, logs, workflow inputs or payloads: the events name case ids, the item id, the interface id, the business date, the attempt count and the document id only; the file carries personal data only as the receiving interface allows, and the content stays in rwb-document behind a SAS link.
- Data Classification and Personal Data Inventory v5 handling for two fields this slice carries: the account key (`account_key`, Indirect identifier) travels in events, workflow inputs and payloads, including `deliverFile(manifest)`, as a reference only (the case id, or the row id of the owning service), the clear key is read by REST under the masking policy and a log holds the id of the read only; `ownerRole` (`owner_role`, Customer data) travels as a role code only, never beside a direct identifier, and a log holds a code or an id only.
